fact: Government Notice No. 189 in Government Gazette No. 7308 publishes the National Broadband Policy, which the Minister of Information and Communication Technology, Dr P. Mushelenga, signed on 27 July 2020 and issued to the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia as policy guidelines under section 7 of the Communications Act 2009; the gazette is dated 14 August 2020.

The article says the National Digital Strategy launched in 2025, with the Sixth National Development Plan, charts digital infrastructure through 2025/26 to 2029/30, with a target of raising internet use from 53% to 90% by 2030; the period had not ended and no successor is named.
Minister Emma Theofelus said on 2026-01-29 that the review of the National Broadband Policy has been finalised and new broadband targets will be implemented from October 2026.
